services.name: Executive Charters
services.desc: The fastest and most convenient way to get from point A to point B. Weather you need to get to a meeting in New York in under two hours or want to travel to Martha’s Vineyard, Nantucket, or any other location, there is no comparison to our helicopters in speed, luxury, and convenience. Our turbine engine helicopters and highly experienced pilots provide unparalleled safety and reliability. services.name: Helicopter Tours
services.desc: Schedule a private tour for up to 5 people in one of our luxurious turbine powered helicopters. Chose from our selection of guided city and shoreline tours, perfect for dates, birthdays, anniversaries, special events, or those looking to see the city from above with friends and family. Custom tours are available on request if you are looking to fly for longer, see specific locations, or takeoff and land from areas other than Norwood Airport. Boston Executive Helicopters offers pre-planned tours of Boston, the North and South Shores, Cape Cod, and the Islands.
